evals.prompt: Can you write a PR description for my changes? I refactored our config loader to read settings from environment variables instead of a hardcoded config file. Before this, the app would fail to start if config.json wasn't present. Now it reads from env vars with sensible defaults, and falls back to config.json if it exists. This was needed because our deployment to Kubernetes kept failing — the config file wasn't being mounted correctly. I updated the tests to set env vars instead of writing temp files.
evals.expected_output: A PR description with a clear first line summarising the refactor, followed by a body explaining the problem (Kubernetes deployment failures due to missing config.json), the solution (env vars with config.json fallback), and mentioning the test updates.

evals.prompt: I just finished adding dark mode to our React app and staged everything. The changes touch: a new ThemeContext and ThemeProvider in src/context/theme.tsx, a useTheme hook in src/hooks/useTheme.ts, updates to about 15 components to use CSS variables instead of hardcoded colors, a new theme toggle button component, localStorage persistence for the user's theme preference, and updated jest tests. Can you write a commit message for all of this?
